tools.name: search_equipment
tools.description: Search the equipment registry by model name, brand or code, ranked by relevance. Optionally narrow to a section (slug, e.g. line-array, moving-head).

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Item card by canonical code (GW-XXXXXX): specifications, brand, section, compatible amplification.

tools.name: find_compatible
tools.description: What fits an item and what it fits: compatibility links (stands, amplifiers, cases, cables, accessories, consumables) with conditions and trust level, plus amplifiers and processors named in the specs. By code.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Registry of event industry services: groups (sound, lighting, rigging, logistics, crew…) and the services in them with canonical slugs. Optionally one group and a language (ru|en).

tools.name: rig_metrics
tools.description: Rig metrics for a list of item codes: total weight and power draw, plus a check for missing amplifiers.
